markets: Visalia / Tulare County (Visalia, West Visalia-Goshen, Tulare, Porterville, Dinuba)
profile.org_note: One office in Visalia (5607 Avenida de los Robles) runs everything; there are no divisions or regional presidents. Joseph A. Leal (President & Co-CEO) and Paul Lucatuorto (Co-CEO, also a principal of capital partner Presidio Residential Capital) sit at the top; land runs through Rob Leal (VP of Operations & Acquisitions) and Nic Peters (Entitlements & Acquisitions Manager); finance through Nicholas Stygar (Finance Controller), with no CFO published. The exact legal entity is not stated on the site; the California DRE sales licence at the same address is held by SJV Construction Services, Inc. (issued 2024-11-05).
profile.summary: Conventional private for-sale homebuilder founded in Visalia in 2013; entry-level and move-up detached homes in California's southern San Joaquin Valley, about 550 closings a year (552 in 2024, $245M revenue) and 5,500 cumulative closings as of November 2026, selling in 19 neighborhoods with four more due from 2027. Its land and projects have been funded through joint ventures with Presidio Residential Capital of San Diego since 2013 (40 communities by mid-2024), and a Presidio principal is listed as Co-CEO, so the land-capital decision sits with Leal and Presidio together. A land banker would be competing with, or working alongside, that single JV equity source.
